lines: 391,000 stars in under a year. This is OpenClaw.
The AI that really does things, on your own computer.
It meets you in the chats you use: WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, iMessage and over 20 more.
Plus native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux.
Your state, memory and credentials live on your hardware.
Every message flows into one local Gateway, the control plane for sessions, tools and channels.
Claude, Codex or a local model: plugins you swap without changing anything else.
Inbound messages count as untrusted. Unknown senders need your approval first.
One line installs it on macOS, Linux or Windows.
Then onboard: it checks model access, creates the workspace and configures the Gateway.
Hundreds of contributors build it in the open, led by an independent non-profit foundation.
Backed by donors like Amazon, OpenAI and Red Hat.
MIT licensed. Your assistant, on your devices.
